elements.label: Woman turning her head toward her colleague (actor performance)
elements.change_other: live-action head turn / reaction glance; no graphic animation

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Broadband onset with sustained harmonics after the event (~81.8 s); a music note, nothing visual syncs with it.

pattern.description: Two-shot of live-action actors: the woman turns her head and gives a skeptical side-glance at her colleague as he starts speaking ('Jim, you won't believe this').
pattern.why_premium: A held, naturally lit two-shot with a timed actor reaction lands the comedic/problem beat with human emotion instead of on-screen text.

build_hint.gsap: Footage only: no tween on the scene itself. If recreated, hold the clip and let the cut timing carry it; optional gsap.to(clip, {scale: 1.0, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out'}) for a subtle settle.
build_hint.remotion: Single <Sequence>/<OffthreadVideo> for the clip; no animation beyond the footage, cut on the dialogue line.

notes: Camera verdict is none; the scale 0.87 sum reflects the woman's head turn inside b01, not a camera move. b02/b03 are tiny changes on the man's sleeve at the frame edge and were not listed as separate elements.
